ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a motor test data table. It can be read that the data in the No load Test row are 400 V, 6 A, 200 W; the data in the Blocked Rotor Test row are 90 V, 15 A, 1200 W. Then reason: The problem gives the full-load output power as 10 kW and the full-load line current as 20 A. According to the specified method, ignore the no-load test copper loss, therefore take the no-load power 200 W as constant loss. Ignore the blocked-rotor test iron loss, therefore take the 1200 W in the blocked-rotor test at 15 A as copper loss, and scale it to full load according to the square of current: P_cu,FL = 1200 × (20/15)^2 = 2133.3 W. Total loss = 200 + 2133.3 = 2333.3 W. The full-load input power is estimated as output power plus loss: 10000 + 2333.3 = 12333.3 W. Efficiency = 10000 / 12333.3 = 0.8108, about 81%.

raw_record.question_text: A 3-phase, 10 kW, 400 V, 4-pole, 50 Hz, star-connected induction motor draws 20 A on full load. Its no-load and blocked rotor test data are given in the image. Neglecting copper loss in the no-load test and core loss in the blocked rotor test, estimate the motor's full-load efficiency.

method.method_draft: First describe/read the image table values: no-load watts = 200 W and blocked-rotor watts = 1200 W at 15 A. From the text, take full-load output as 10 kW and full-load line current as 20 A. Treat 200 W as constant loss. Scale the blocked-rotor copper loss to full load: P_cu,FL = 1200*(20/15)^2. Add losses = 200 + P_cu,FL. Estimate input = 10000 + losses and compute efficiency = 10000/input, giving about 81%.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是电机试验数据表。可读到 No load Test 一行的数据为 400 V、6 A、200 W；Blocked Rotor Test 一行的数据为 90 V、15 A、1200 W。再推理：题目给出满载输出功率为 10 kW，满载线电流为 20 A。按指定方法，忽略空载试验铜损，因此把空载功率 200 W 作为恒定损耗。忽略堵转试验铁损，因此把堵转试验在 15 A 时的 1200 W 作为铜损，并按电流平方比例折算到满载：P_cu,FL = 1200 × (20/15)^2 = 2133.3 W。总损耗 = 200 + 2133.3 = 2333.3 W。满载输入功率估计为输出功率加损耗：10000 + 2333.3 = 12333.3 W。效率 = 10000 / 12333.3 = 0.8108，约为 81%。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the most direct loss-segregation route: it uses the two test watt readings as loss measurements and scales only the blocked-rotor copper loss to full-load current before forming efficiency.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the test table in the image: no-load test gives approximately 400 V, 6 A, 200 W; blocked-rotor test gives approximately 90 V, 15 A, 1200 W. The watt readings are the essential visual data.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text for the motor rating/output power 10 kW, full-load current 20 A, three-phase star-connected context, and the stated approximations about neglecting no-load copper loss and blocked-rotor core loss.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard induction-motor test interpretation: with no-load copper loss neglected, no-load input power is constant/core plus mechanical loss; with blocked-rotor core loss neglected, blocked-rotor input power is copper loss at the blocked-rotor current. Copper loss varies as current squared. Efficiency = output/(output + total losses).

method.method_draft: First read and state the image test values. Use the blocked-rotor row to compute the equivalent per-phase series resistance: R_eq = 1200/(3*15^2). Because the motor is star-connected, full-load phase current is the line current, 20 A. Compute full-load copper loss as 3*(20^2)*R_eq. Add the no-load constant loss from the image, 200 W. With rated mechanical output from the text equal to 10 kW, calculate efficiency as 10000/(10000 + full-load copper loss + 200), which rounds to 81%.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图是 no-load 和 blocked-rotor test 数据表，列出了电压、电流、功率。图中可读数值为：No load test：400 V，6 A，200 W；Blocked Rotor Test：90 V，15 A，1200 W。

推理：按题意忽略空载试验铜耗，因此空载输入功率 200 W 作为恒定损耗。堵转试验忽略铁耗，因此堵转输入功率 1200 W 作为等效串联铜耗，用其求每相等效串联电阻：R_eq = 1200/(3 × 15^2) = 1200/675 = 1.7778 Ω。电机为星形连接，所以满载相电流等于线电流，即 20 A。满载铜耗 = 3 × 20^2 × 1.7778 = 2133.3 W。总输入功率估计为输出功率加损耗：10000 + 2133.3 + 200 = 12333.3 W。效率 = 10000/12333.3 = 0.8108 ≈ 81%。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route is parameter-based rather than directly using the blocked-rotor wattage as a scaled loss. It first converts the blocked-rotor test into an equivalent per-phase resistance, then computes full-load copper loss from 3I^2R. It is mathematically equivalent to method 1, so it is only weakly distinct, but it follows a different executable circuit-parameter workflow.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image table entries: no-load test row shows 400 V, 6 A, 200 W, and blocked-rotor test row shows about 90 V, 15 A, 1200 W. The blocked-rotor current and wattage are used to extract equivalent resistance; the no-load wattage is used as constant loss.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text for star connection, full-load line current 20 A, rated output 10 kW, and the instructions on which losses to neglect in each test.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For a star-connected three-phase motor, line current equals phase current. In a blocked-rotor test with core loss neglected, three-phase power equals 3I_phase^2 R_eq, so R_eq = P_BR/(3I_BR^2). At full load, total copper loss is 3I_FL^2R_eq. No-load watts, with copper loss neglected, are treated as constant/core plus mechanical loss.
